events.name: publish_affordance_shown
events.trigger: The assigned publish control finishes rendering for an eligible document. Not at assignment time, because a control that never painted was never seen.
events.decision: Establish a common exposed denominator that includes eligible users who never enter the publish flow.

events.name: publish_flow_opened
events.trigger: The assigned control's compact popover or review surface finishes rendering.
events.decision: Measure whether the visible affordance moves eligible users into either arm's publish flow.

events.name: publish_warning_shown
events.trigger: A checklist item flags something before the user can publish.
events.decision: Find which objection the product itself raises most often, and whether raising it helps or stops people.

events.name: publish_flow_abandoned
events.trigger: The opened publish surface closes without a publish.
events.decision: Separate eligible users who never entered from those who entered either arm and still stopped.

events.name: document_published
events.trigger: The document becomes publicly readable. This is the primary activation outcome, not proof that a reader arrived.
events.decision: Measure the primary outcome, split by whether it is the account's first publish.

events.name: public_link_copied
events.trigger: The published link is copied. Kept separate from publishing on purpose: 31 publishes produced 11 link copies in the cohort, and merging them would hide that gap.
events.decision: Measure sharing intent after publication without claiming that a reader arrived.

events.name: public_link_opened
events.trigger: An unauthenticated or external reader successfully loads the public document.
events.decision: Measure realized reader value without collecting reader identity or document content.
